title: 第23章 打斗第24章 碾压
content_zh:
至于为什么调解没有用，就会因为这个佛雷德佣兵团在希望之城都很有名了！
是一位颇有实力的侯爵手下狗腿子之一！
不要说你只是个守卫队大队长了，怕就算吉恩去了人家也不一定给面子啊！
吉恩一听好家伙，这也是个难题啊，搬运协会的成员是自己领地的领民，但是正常他失误打碎了客户的产品，致使客户财产受到了损失肯定是要照价赔偿的，但是问题来了这次搬运协会工人也遇难了一位，然后这个叫做佛雷德的雇佣兵团好像还挺有实力了，听布朗宁讲，也对正常普通雇佣兵自己都难养活，没有实力怎么会掏钱请人搬东西？
现在一方觉得自己受到巨大的损失，不肯罢休！
一方觉得自己死了人，必须要给个必须要给个说法，毕竟搬运前没有说过这批物资里面有魔法物品或者说有危险的物品！
所以自己并不知情才造成了人员财产损失！
“哼，今天天王老子来了都不行，我们佛雷德雇佣兵的东西你们还想赖？也不去新大陆打听打听？”
隔的老远吉恩就听到一阵嚣张的话。
“你们的陪我儿子的命来啊，呜呜～”
然后就是一个声嘶力竭的女声传来。
“滚开，我不欺负普通人！
你儿子打翻了我们团这次高价采购的金属腐蚀药剂难道就不应该赔钱吗？”
还是之前那个声音，不过这时候吉恩他们已经赶到码头上了，因为骑马视线比较高，隔着人群已经可以看到码头那边有个空地，还看到地上躺着一个好像被火烧火的人形物体躺在地上，旁边地上瘫坐着两个女人，一个年纪大的一个还挺年轻的，两人眼睛都流着眼泪，身边还站着一个死死盯着说话男人的小男孩，他们面前就是那个说话嚣张的男人，身着一身灰色皮甲，胸口好像绣着字，腰上也是挎着一把武器不是剑是刀，左臂上带着一个小圆盾，他身后闲着二三十个穿着差不多武器各不相同的男女，应该都是这个叫佛雷德雇佣兵团的人，看精气神应该都小有实力（都是练家子对付普通人好使）！
他们后面是几十个相互搀扶着的男人，看衣着普通大部分都打着补丁，就知道这些人应该是搬运协会的工人。
“布朗宁这个佛雷德佣兵团很有厉害？”
吉恩转头看向跟在一边的布朗宁，不过布朗宁却不时回头看着萨娜身上的铠甲，之前见面的时候也没有发现这个小小的男爵手下的人竟然还有铠甲？看起来好像还不错的样子。
“哦，吉恩爵士，这个佛雷德佣兵团在希望之城也是很有名气的，因为它是瓦安家族的佣兵团！”
布朗宁回过神来说道。
“哦？瓦安家族？”

吉恩疑惑道？格林帝国在新大陆有一位王爵四位公爵，但是都没有瓦安家族在列啊？
“怪我没有说清楚，瓦安家族是一位侯爵家族，不过瓦安家族最近十几年在涅滨侯爵的治理下，势力日益上涨！
拿全领地人口来说，已经比得上普通公爵了！
涅滨侯爵也算是希望之城的风云人物。”
布朗宁说道。
当然算是风云人物了，整个新大陆格林帝国势力里面就他的水军最强！
“哦！
那佛雷德佣兵团是怎么回事？”
吉恩又问道？
“贵族领主自己的佣兵团存在的意义，就是贵族领主需要处理一些无法正常处理的事。”
布朗宁说道。
content_en:
As for why mediation is useless, it’s because the Fred Mercenary Group is famous in the City of Hope!
He is one of the henchmen of a powerful Marquis!
Don't say that you are just a captain of the guard team. I'm afraid that even if Jean goes away, he may not be able to give you face!
Gene heard that this was also a problem. Members of the Moving Association were citizens of their own territories, but if he accidentally broke a customer's product and caused damage to the customer's property, he would definitely have to pay compensation according to the price. But here comes the problem. This time, a worker from the Moving Association also died. And this mercenary group named Fred seems to be quite powerful. According to Browning, it is difficult for ordinary mercenaries to support themselves. How can you pay for people to move things if you don't have the strength?
Now one party feels that it has suffered a huge loss and refuses to give up!
One party feels that someone has died and must give an explanation. After all, they did not say before moving that there were magic items or dangerous items in this batch of supplies!
Therefore, he caused personal and property losses without knowing it!
"Hmph, even if the King of Heaven is here today, do you still want to rely on our Fred mercenary's stuff? Why don't you go to the New World to inquire about it?"
Far away, Jean heard some arrogant words.
"It's up to you to accompany my son, wuwu~"
Then a hoarse female voice came.
"Go away, I don't bully ordinary people!
Shouldn't your son lose money if he knocked over the metal corrosion agent our group purchased at a high price this time? "
It was the same voice as before, but by this time Jean and the others had already arrived at the pier. Because the sight of the horse was relatively high, they could already see an open space on the other side of the pier through the crowd. They also saw a humanoid object lying on the ground that seemed to have been burned by fire. Two women were slumped on the ground next to them. One was older and the other was quite young. Both of them had tears in their eyes. There was also a man standing next to him who was staring at the man who was talking. The little boy in front of them was the man who spoke arrogantly. He was wearing a gray leather armor with words embroidered on his chest. He also had a weapon on his waist, not a sword but a knife. He had a small buckler on his left arm. Behind him were twenty or thirty men and women with similar clothes and different weapons. They should all be members of the Fred Mercenary Group. Judging from their energy and spirit, they should all have some strength (they are all trainers who are good at dealing with ordinary people)!
Behind them were dozens of men supporting each other. Judging from their ordinary clothes, most of which were patched, it was obvious that these people must be workers from the moving association.
"Browning's Fred mercenary group is very powerful?"
Gene turned to look at Browning who was following him, but Browning looked back at Sana's armor from time to time. When they met before, he didn't realize that this little baron's subordinates actually had armor? It looks pretty good.
"Oh, Sir Jean, this Fred mercenary group is also very famous in the City of Hope, because it is the mercenary group of the Waan family!"
Browning came to his senses and said.
"Oh? The Waan family?"
Gene wondered? The Green Empire has a king and four dukes in the New World, but none of them include the Vaan family?
"I blame me for not making it clear. The Waan family is a marquis family, but in the past ten years, under the governance of Marquis Niebin, the Waan family has become increasingly powerful!
Taking the population of the entire territory as an example, it is already comparable to that of an ordinary duke!
The Marquis of Nirvana is also considered a man of the hour in the City of Hope. "
Browning said.
Of course he is a man of the hour, and he has the strongest naval force among the forces of the Green Empire in the entire New World!
"Oh!
So what happened to the Fred Mercenary Group? "
Gene asked again?
"The significance of the existence of the noble lord's own mercenary group is that the noble lord needs to deal with some things that cannot be handled normally."
Browning said.
